actions.desc: The treant magically animates 2 trees or 2d6 shrubs it can see within 60 feet of it. The trees use the statistics of an **awakened tree**, and the shrubs use the statistics of an **awakened shrub**. The animated plants act as allies of the treant, obeying its spoken commands. The plants remain for 1 hour, until the treant dies, or until the treant dismisses them as a bonus action.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Анимате Треес»; тип: action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Animate Trees

actions.desc: The treant calls to the roots beneath up to two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 STR save or be restrained by roots until the end of its next turn. The treant can target only creatures in contact with the ground and can't target creatures in contact with a manufactured floor, such as the wooden floor of a building.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Халт Интрудерс»; тип: bonus_action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Halt Intruders

actions.desc: The treant makes three Slam attacks, or it makes two Throw Rock attacks. If two Slam attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 17 STR save or be knocked prone.

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 22 (4d6+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slam

actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 33 (5d10+6) bludgeoning damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием дальнего боя: +10 к попаданию, дистанция 60/180 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 33 (5к10+6) дробящего урона.
actions.name: Throw Rock

traits.desc: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.
